observations: argus_skill.apps._runtime re-exports build_life_runner from _runtime_construction and defines _SkillLoopRunner by composing _RunnerConstructionMixin with the execute/stage/self-reply mixins.
For the non-memory branch, build_life_runner imports _SkillLoopRunner from _runtime and returns _SkillLoopRunner(args, seed_thread_id=seed_thread_id).

_RunnerConstructionMixin.__init__ constructs engineer/reviewer/planner/manager/curator role backends, derives project/global usage roots, sets _active_usage_mission_id to None, and calls self._set_usage_context(None) before constructing self.manager.
_distinct_backends explicitly includes manager_backend; _set_usage_context therefore attempts set_usage_context on the Manager backend along with the other distinct backends.
The exact pinned _set_usage_context call supplies project_root=self._usage_project_root, global_root=self._usage_global_root, and mission_id=None.
The exact pinned AgentCliBackend.set_usage_context implementation stores the supplied project/global roots and normalizes the empty/None mission identifier to _usage_mission_id=None under a lock.

After that base context setup, _RunnerConstructionMixin constructs Manager with usage_context=self.task_usage_context, which is a context manager that later rebinds usage context to a supplied mission_id and restores the previous value afterward.
bounded_slice.acceptance_effect: This resolves the imported constructor leaf for the exact non-memory AgentCliBackend path: although front_door._ensure_manager_runner itself has no explicit usage-context setter after build_life_runner, build_life_runner constructs _SkillLoopRunner whose constructor establishes project/global usage context on manager_backend before Manager is constructed and before the runner is returned. The initial mission identifier is explicitly None, so this proves base ledger context, not a non-null mission binding. End-to-end mission-scoped Manager execution remains unresolved and Phase 1 remains open.
exclusions: No claim is made about the memory backend branch.
No claim is made that a non-null mission_id is established before build_life_runner returns.
No inference is made about gateway_run_exec, provider internals, later Manager execution paths, other CLI actions, Work execution, protected-primary execution, or repository-wide callers.
contradictions: Any claim that the exact non-memory build_life_runner path returns a Manager runner with no project/global usage context setup is contradicted by the pinned constructor and AgentCliBackend setter bodies.
Any stronger claim that the constructor establishes a non-null mission-specific usage context before return is not supported; the constructor calls _set_usage_context(None).
